### Agents and chat

- Schedule a Rich Chat message to send later; it survives daemon restarts.
- Reset a session with a handoff summary, then reopen earlier ones from Previous sessions.
- Queued messages now steer a running agent as soon as its prompt is in flight.
- Resumed Claude sessions keep the model you asked for.
- Claude sessions in Rich Chat can use Claude-in-Chrome and Artifacts.
- Starting an agent uses a minimal one-box draft with the same composer as live chat.

### Usage limits

- The status bar shows ring chips for your Claude, Codex and Antigravity usage limits.
- Tap a chip to see every limit and choose which two stay pinned.
- Each limit shows percent used, a reset countdown and the local end time.
- Limits come from each vendor's own CLI, and no credential files are read.

### Workspace and code

- HTML files preview rendered in a sandbox, with a Source toggle.
- Rich Chat renders closed html code blocks as sandboxed Preview and Source cards.
- The VCS tab lists submodule commits inline and opens their diffs.
- Kotlin code navigation now uses JetBrains' kotlin-lsp.
- The language server popup offers one-click enable and a project-aware language list.

### Fixes

- Worktree and project agent tabs now always match the sidebar.
- Resetting a session carries its pin over to the replacement.
- Mermaid diagrams with line breaks in labels show correctly in fullscreen.
- Status bar popups stay above fullscreen panes.
- Updated rustls to address RUSTSEC-2026-0346 to 0349.
